about_short_description.short_description: Revibe is a B2C marketplace for refurbished electronics in the UAE and KSA

product.name: Refurbished Smartphones
product.description: Marketplace sales of refurbished and used smartphones, primarily Apple iPhones and Samsung Galaxy devices, in multiple models, storage capacities, colors, SIM configurations, and cosmetic conditions.

product.name: Refurbished MacBooks and Laptops
product.description: Refurbished and used notebook computers from Apple, Dell, Lenovo, HP, Microsoft, Acer, and Samsung, offered across business, consumer, Chromebook, and performance configurations.

product.name: Refurbished iPads and Tablets
product.description: Refurbished tablet devices, including Apple iPads, sold through Revibe’s online electronics marketplace in a range of models and configurations.

product.name: Refurbished Apple Watches and Smartwatches
product.description: Refurbished Apple Watch models, including Series 7, Series 9, and Series 10, with different case sizes, colors, straps, and GPS or cellular connectivity.

product.name: Accessories and Audio
product.description: Consumer electronics accessories such as AirPods, headphones, speakers, chargers, power banks, cables, cases, and screen protectors.

product.name: Gaming Electronics
product.description: Gaming-related electronics and equipment available through Revibe’s online marketplace, including refurbished or used devices and associated accessories where available.
